user.title: Energy Flow Mapper
user.description: Adds an admin panel to view and edit the energy dashboard configuration as a diagram. Your energy settings are not changed by the setup.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Energy Flow Mapper is already set up.

init.title: Backups
init.description: Before every save, Energy Flow Mapper backs up your previous energy settings in the Home Assistant configuration folder, so they are part of every Home Assistant backup.

data_description.max_backups: Between 5 and 100. If you lower the number, the oldest backups beyond it are deleted.

not_loaded.message: Energy Flow Mapper is not loaded.

unsupported_energy_api.message: The energy settings of this Home Assistant release are not supported by Energy Flow Mapper.

conflict.message: The energy settings were changed elsewhere in the meantime. Reload and try again.

unknown_device.message: {stat} is not a device in the energy dashboard.

unsupported_energy_api.title: Energy Flow Mapper does not support this Home Assistant release
unsupported_energy_api.description: The energy settings of this Home Assistant release do not match what Energy Flow Mapper expects. To protect your settings, the editor is disabled. Update Energy Flow Mapper, or report the problem if no update is available.
